summary: The source table stops at 10, so every famous city a player tries (New York, Tokyo, Rome, Singapore, Barcelona) costs a life with no rank to explain it. Correct, but punishing and not much fun.
reasons: Casual found 4 (Paris, London, Dubai, Bangkok) and was out of lives after 9 guesses: New York, Tokyo, Rome, Barcelona and Singapore all cost a life as unranked answers.
Wikipedia's 2025 table only lists the top 10, so there are no ranks 11+: no near-miss feedback in classic and nothing to score in Blitz.
The surprises (Macau, Mecca, Antalya) are interesting on reveal, and the matcher handles hk, kl, macao, makkah and constantinople well.
fixes: Drop non-name aliases: SJK Lai Meng and K.L.C.C. (Kuala Lumpur), Al memzar (Dubai), Guzelbag Mahallesi and Kaleici (Antalya), and the truncated 'Krungthepmahanakornamornratanakosinmahintarayutth...' (Bangkok).
If a deeper ranking becomes available (for example a fuller Euromonitor top 100 table), rebuild from it so misses get a rank and the list becomes Blitz-ready; until then keep it out of the dailies.
